title: Cursor/g20 moved correction frame 9d0c
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Negative result. No new κ. On the emitted local word of PR #5708, every one-to-three-contact A2 conjugation keeps its scalar endpoint when exactly one correction is moved onto a different frame of the published one-edge route table. Of the 28,149 frames that can host that meeting, 28,123 do not emit. The 26 that emit raise the paid-query moment on the whole interval `(0, 1)`, by `H4` or by `5 H2 − 2 H4`.

This is a paid-profile obstruction in that finite domain. It is not a scalar-only count, a supplier admission, or a change to the selected exponent `781451/250000000`.

## Task and overlap

Base commit: `626e936ce4d61f2584316914fc71baf96940c512` on canonical `CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds` main. Priority revision 8. Catalogue card `bit-helper-contract`. Scope status: **refined**.

The card says to review the #5679/#5708 chain and stop when a proposed cut does not improve the paid moment. Session r69 takes item 2 of the ordered eligible list: the BIT row, and within it the moved-frame clause left open by #6290, #6305, and `research/g20-neutral-two-step-obstruction`.

Ordered list, after dropping the delivered 19 October handoff index and work already on main, in open PRs, or on a fork `cursor/*` branch:

1. Complex helpers (`p104-side-correction`, `coverage-law-change`).
2. **This package.** BIT (`bit-helper-contract`): one moved correction frame.
3. New decoders and interfaces.
4. Supplier audit.
5. All-size audit.
6. Verification tooling.
7. `bit-new-register-model`.
8. `r437-carrier-integration`.
9. `complex-rank-shape-decoder`.
10. `complex-new-helper-inventory`.

#6290 certified the 765 contact-frame conjugations. #6305 certified four or more contacts with corrections kept on the contact frame. The neutral two-step obstruction states that changed correction frames stay outside its quantifier. Open PR titles and bodies on 2026-11-01 did not contain this one-move domain. The local overlap search had no remote discussion snapshot.

## Validation

Python 3.12, standard library, from the repository root:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/g20-moved-correction-frame/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/g20-moved-correction-frame/verify.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/g20-moved-correction-frame
```

The direct verifier prints

```text
PASS_G20_MOVED_CORRECTION_FRAME candidates=765 moved_trials=28149 missing_edge=28123 emitted_h4=2 emitted_5h2_minus_2h4=24 savings=0 no_new_kappa=true
```

`python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/g20-moved-correction-frame` printed `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` with outcome `negative-result`. Both registered modes passed. Checks raise exceptions, so `-O` does not disable them.

The baseline binding check on this base returned `PASS_RESEARCH_BASELINE_BINDINGS_ONLY` with selected κ `781451/250000000` and admitted BIT saving `17/5000`. That command is not a supplier replay.

Not run: the #5708 integration replay, the 18-call caller, adjoint columns, moduli 101 and 10201, ordinary admission, Lean, Docker, and `make frontier6030-verify`. `check_research_commit.py --check-source-history` was not run because this checkout is shallow. `check_research_commit.py` without that flag passed at `3b58db981b87f090f2a63886edf78bf641b049ae`.

## Credit

The emitted word, route table, and A2 relation are Ali Romman's `research/g20-conjugation-admission`, following Dugongue, ai-nanachi, and the retained G20 lineage. The contact-frame length-1..3 census is unpaidmoon's #6290. The length-4-and-above contact-frame obstruction is Nick Petalas's #6305. The fixed-frame neutral two-step obstruction is the package prepared for @CubeJerry.

Prepared by unpaidmoon with substantial Cursor Grok assistance. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

1. Can two corrections in one interval, or one length-4 conjugation with a moved frame, lower the paid moment? First step: one two-move pair, or one length-4 interval with one moved frame, on this word and route table. No saving seed comes from the one-move census. #6305 already excludes length 4 and above when every correction stays on its contact frame.
2. Do the six neutral one-step neighbors and the 645 common-frame expansions in the #5708 README have an executable rule? The published package does not contain that search.
